display_duration.description: Display duration in seconds. Set to 0.1 — the display() method is a no-op so the matrix is unaffected.

server_mode.description: Set to true on the source Pi to serve plugins and config over HTTP. Set to false (default) on all destination Pi's that pull from the source.

server_port.description: Port the sync server listens on (server mode) or connects to (destination mode)

sync_token.description: Optional shared secret for basic auth. Must be identical on the source and all destinations. Leave empty to disable (local network only).

source_host.description: Hostname or IP of the source Pi (destination mode only)

source_port.description: Port of the sync server on the source Pi (destination mode only)

sync_plugins.description: Sync the plugins/ directory from source

sync_config.description: Sync plugin configuration sections from source config.json. Hardware settings, schedule, timezone, and other Pi-specific keys are always preserved locally.

dry_run.description: Log what would be synced without making any changes

auto_restart.description: Automatically restart the display service when changes are detected after a sync

display_service_name.description: Name of the systemd service to restart when changes are detected

preserve_local_keys.description: Additional top-level config.json keys to always keep from local and never overwrite from source. The following are always preserved regardless: display, schedule, dim_schedule, timezone, location, web_display_autostart, plugin_system, plugin-sync.
